correctness.rationale: The complete 1–7 vertex labeled-graph census visits each edge mask, tests all connected-dominating subsets, performs exact F2 coboundary ranks, and checks graph-isomorphism structure of every one of 252 eligible masks. All 252 have Betti ranks one in degrees 2 and 3. Structural recognition establishes the unique C5*complement(K2) isomorphism type; the 252 count equals 7!/20. A five-free-pair collapse of the witness non-dominating-subset complex establishes the claimed integral groups and an explicit polynomial establishes zero Euler. Every claim is finite or separately proved; no extrapolation.
